guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Dow Points Dashboard
guide.description: Open the Dow Protocol points page and connect a wallet. BNB Chain is the primary network for XP tracking. BNB Chain: MetaMask, Rabby or any EVM wallet works for the main dashboard Sui: bind a Sui wallet too if you plan to use the Volo vault
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your X Account
guide.description: Link X from the quest list for 50 XP. This gates everything else, since both the posting quest and the referral tier need a connected X account.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Post About Dow Protocol and Submit It for Review
guide.description: Publish a post about Dow on X, then submit the link through the dashboard for approval. That pays 50 XP and unlocks referrals. Write something specific about the vault or the receivables model, since reviewed quests reject copy-paste filler.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link Telegram and Discord
guide.description: Connect both accounts from the quest list for 50 XP each. One-time quests, about a minute of work.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit Stablecoins Into an Open Vault
guide.description: When a subscription window opens on the Dow Protocol app, deposit stablecoins into the Dow E-Commerce Financing Vault on BNB Chain or Dowsure Stable #1 on Sui. Vaults run a 90-day term, so plan around the lock first. You can buy stablecoins on Bybit and withdraw them, or move funds from another chain with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. F
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Referral Link
guide.description: Once your post clears review, the dashboard generates an invite link. Each verified signup adds Referral XP, and referrals are the only quest that scales past a one-time payout.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Task XP and Referral XP
guide.description: Your balance splits into Task XP, Referral XP and a running total. Check after each quest to confirm points registered, since social verifications sometimes need a refresh.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
